title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Set a PDF password for the report (Password protect the document using a user and admin passwords) – No control add-in and APIs
summary: The OnPreRendering report trigger in Business Central 2025 release wave 1 enables developers to add PDF password protection to exported reports using user and admin passwords without requiring control add-ins or APIs. The trigger runs after the report dataset is finalized but before rendering, allowing protection settings to be added to the rendering payload.
key_points: OnPreRendering trigger available in runtime version 15.0 and Business Central 2025 wave 1
Add user password to require authentication to open PDF, and optional admin password for full access
Protection settings are configured by creating a JsonObject and adding it to the RenderingPayload
Password protection works for both standard report exports and Attach as PDF feature
No external tools, APIs, or control add-ins needed for basic password protection

quotes.text: OnPreRendering (Report) trigger: Runs when a report dataset has been finalized and before the output artifact has been rendered.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the precise timing when developers can add password protection to PDF reports

quotes.text: Password protect the document using a user and admin passwords.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the two-level password protection capability available through the trigger

quotes.text: Notice that if this element is empty, the platform will apply the user password to this field.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important behavior to understand when only user password is specified
